Description: PostgreSQL, live updates over WebSockets, multi-server notifications, data clean-up and monitoring.
Refresh tokens, remote sign-out and wipe, roles, multiple teams, HTTPS and encryption on the device.
Photos and files, GPS location and map, custom form fields, voice notes.
Assignment, due dates, notifications, reports and exports, history and undo, partial sync.
Admin conflict rules, automatic text merge (CRDT), rule-based suggestions and duplicate detection.
GitHub Actions builds and releases, signed APK, Telugu / Hindi / English.

As a team lead, I want the server on PostgreSQL so that several servers can share one database as the team grows.

Acceptance criteria:
- Built-in PostgreSQL (PGlite) works with no install
- DATABASE_URL switches to a real PostgreSQL server
- All automated tests pass on both

As a field worker, I want changes from teammates to appear within a second so that I never work on stale data.

Acceptance criteria:
- Device connects to /api/live after login
- A change on one device reaches others in under 1 s
- Falls back to normal sync when the socket drops

As an operator, I want every server instance told about changes so that live updates work behind a load balancer.

Acceptance criteria:
- PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY when DATABASE_URL is set
- In-process events with the built-in database

As an admin, I want old tombstones and logs removed so that the database stays small.

Acceptance criteria:
- Retention days set in Admin
- Daily job removes old tombstones and trims logs
- A device that missed the clean-up re-syncs automatically

As an admin, I want live charts of sync latency and failures so that I can spot problems.

Acceptance criteria:
- /metrics in Prometheus format
- Admin shows last 60 minutes per minute
- p50 / p95 latency, applied, conflicts, failures

As a user, I want to stay logged in safely so that I am not asked for my password every 15 minutes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Access token lasts 15 minutes
- Refresh token rotates on every use
- Re-using an old refresh token signs the device out

Summary: Remote sign-out and wipe of a lost phone
Description:
As an admin, I want to sign out a lost phone and erase its data so that records stay private.

Acceptance criteria:
- Sign out, or sign out + erase, from Admin or My devices
- Device is blocked within 30 seconds
- Erase runs the next time the phone connects

Summary: Roles: admin, supervisor, field worker, viewer
Description:
As an admin, I want roles so that each person can only do what their job needs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Viewer cannot change anything
- Only supervisors and admins assign and delete others records
- Server enforces every rule

As an organiser, I want separate teams so that one server can serve several groups.

Acceptance criteria:
- Create a team or join with an invite code
- A team never sees another team data
- Admin can regenerate the code

As a field worker, I want my phone data encrypted so that a stolen phone does not leak records.

Acceptance criteria:
- AES-256 with a key from my password
- Unlock screen works offline
- Photos are encrypted too

Summary: HTTPS option for the laptop server
Description:
As a tester, I want to run the server over HTTPS so that browsers on other devices allow encryption.

Acceptance criteria:
- npm run start:https makes a certificate
- Browsers on the Wi-Fi can open it

Summary: Photos and files with resumable upload
Description:
As a field worker, I want to attach photos offline so that evidence is captured on site.

Acceptance criteria:
- Photos are compressed and saved offline
- Upload resumes in 256 KB chunks after a drop
- Checksum verified; teammates can view them

As a supervisor, I want records on a map so that I can plan visits.

Acceptance criteria:
- Use my location on a record
- Map tab shows coloured pins by status
- Tap the map to add a record there

As an admin, I want extra fields such as Households affected so that the form fits our survey.

Acceptance criteria:
- Text, number, date, choice list, yes/no
- Required fields enforced
- Fields appear in exports

As a field worker, I want to dictate notes so that I can record findings hands-free.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dictate button in browsers that support speech
- Keyboard microphone on Android
- English, Telugu and Hindi

Summary: Assign records and set due dates
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to assign work with a due date so that everyone knows what to do next.

Acceptance criteria:
- Assigned to and due date on every record
- Filter "assigned to me" and "overdue"
- Overdue shown in red

As a field worker, I want to be told about new assignments and due work so that nothing is missed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Bell with unread count
- Phone notification when the app is in the background
- Hourly due-date reminders

Summary: Reports and export to CSV, Excel and PDF
Description:
As a supervisor, I want reports and exports so that I can share progress with my manager.

Acceptance criteria:
- Charts by status, priority and assignee
- Overdue list
- Export CSV / Excel / PDF with filters

As a user, I want to see every version and restore an old one so that mistakes can be undone.

Acceptance criteria:
- History lists each version with who and when
- Restore makes a new version
- Works across devices

As a field worker with a small phone, I want only my records on the device so that it saves space and data.

Acceptance criteria:
- Keep all, mine, or one area
- Records outside the scope are removed from the phone
- Changing scope re-syncs

Summary: Conflict rules chosen by the admin
Description:
As an admin, I want to choose per field what happens on a conflict so that the rules fit our work.

Acceptance criteria:
- Later save wins, a person decides, or merge text
- Saved per team
- Applied on the server

As a field worker, I want both people notes kept when we edit at the same time so that nothing is lost.

Acceptance criteria:
- Notes use a Yjs text CRDT
- Both offline edits survive in any order
- Re-sending the same edit is harmless

As a field worker, I want hints for priority, status and possible duplicates so that data is consistent.

Acceptance criteria:
- Keyword rules suggest priority and status with a reason
- Similar title, location or within 100 m flagged as duplicate
- Conflicts show a suggested combined text

Summary: GitHub Actions: tests, APK and release
Description:
As a developer, I want every push tested and built so that a fresh APK is always one download away.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tests on PGlite and PostgreSQL
- Debug APK + website zip published as a GitHub release
- Emulator start check with screenshot

As a release manager, I want a signed APK so that the app can be updated and later published.

Acceptance criteria:
- Keystore kept in GitHub secrets
- Release APK signed when secrets exist
- Version code increases every build

As a field worker, I want the app in my language so that it is easy to use.

Acceptance criteria:
- Language picker on every screen
- All text translated
- Test checks no text is missing
